blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At least 14 Filipinos were among those illegally recruited by Russia to join its war against Ukraine, an international expert said. Many foreign nationals, particularly from South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Central Asia, were being illegally recruited and trafficked into the Russian military, the European External Action Service (EEAS) said. The reported number of recruited Filipinos is 14, including one who was reportedly killed and another who is being held as a prisoner of war, said Munira Mustaffa, executive director of Chasseur Group and senior fellow at Verve Research, citing data from the Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment […]...
